name: Toast Notification Script
description: Toast Notification Script is a Windows 10/11 tool designed for Intune Remediations to deliver native toast notifications to the logged-on user. It supports weekly reminders, reboot prompts, and general announcements with configurable scheduling, branding, languages, and snooze/dismiss actions. Includes a detection script, configuration validation, and robust logging to support reliable remote remediation.
author: Martin Bengtsson

securityCheck.aiSummary: No evidence of obfuscation, credential theft, data exfiltration, or malicious payloads. The script fetches configuration from a remote URL, which raises config integrity and trust concerns if the config is tampered or not signed. There is a potential XXE risk in XML parsing, and some brittle boolean handling in config parsing. Overall, the main security considerations center on strong config integrity (signing, schema validation, and possibly signature verification) and ensuring XML parsing is done securely. Minor PS hygiene improvements noted (removing -UseBasicParsing and using robust exit behavior).
